name: Shu Yun
description: The ancient Jeskai khan who convenes the khans and offers his life to Ojutai to spare his clan.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun dictates a history of Tarkir at Dirgur and prepares to receive the arriving khans at his unprecedented summit.
timeline.quote: This meeting, this council of khans, was Shu Yun's desperate effort to improve the odds of survival.

timeline.summary: Alesha, Reyhan, Yasova, and Tasigur arrive at Dirgur and bicker.
Shu Yun halts a quarrel and urges the khans to stand together against the dragons.
timeline.quote: We must stand together, or our ways of life will vanish from the world.

timeline.summary: Reyhan blames Yasova for the deaths of thousands, but Shu Yun interposes under his truce, and the khans forgive her.
timeline.quote: Shu Yun interposed himself between Reyhan and Yasova.

timeline.summary: The khans disagree over whether to open the cocoon, kill Ugin, or kill the brood-lords; Shu Yun insists on balance and seeking Ugin.
timeline.quote: The destruction of the dragons is no better than the destruction of the clans.

timeline.summary: Bells announce Silumgar's brood and Ojutai's brood, which merge and fly together toward Dirgur.
timeline.quote: Out over the water, the two massive flights of dragons raced toward each other, crashed together…and merged

timeline.summary: The khans realize someone leaked the summit, and Alesha suspects Shu Yun, who denies it; Tasigur has vanished.
timeline.quote: Someone must have told them about our little summit," said Reyhan.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun takes the Annals scrolls from Quan to hide them and leaps from the window onto Silumgar's dragon, killing it with his tattooed palm.
timeline.quote: His dragon tattoo flashed with magical energy, and he slammed his palm into a very particular spot on the dragon's skull.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun hides the scroll case in a room beneath the stronghold and swallows the key.
timeline.quote: He shut the door, took the key, swallowed it with a shudder, and ran back to the courtyard.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun kneels before Ojutai and offers his life to spare the Jeskai; Ojutai freezes him to death.
timeline.quote: The khan of the Jeskai fell.

timeline.summary: Dragons assault Dirgur Stronghold, Tasigur betrays the khans, Shu Yun offers his life to Ojutai, and Reyhan dies helping Yasova and Alesha escape; the clans fall.
timeline.quote: Reyhan dies during the fighting to secure an escape for Yasova and Alesha

timeline.summary: Yasova identifies Tae Jin's dragon mark as that of a ghostfire warrior and demands to know how he exists.
timeline.quote: You wear the dragon mark of a ghostfire warrior.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin explains that his mother was a scribe of Shu Yun who survived Ojutai's purge and that his master taught him the ghostfire blade.
timeline.quote: She survived Ojutai's purge and dedicated herself to saving what she could of the history and knowledge of the Jeskai Way.

relations.quote: The khan of the Jeskai fell.

relations.note: He is Shu Yun's most trusted scribe.
relations.quote: Shu Yun turned to his most trusted scribe, Quan.

relations.note: Ojutai freezes him with his breath after Shu Yun offers his life.
relations.quote: Ojutai's jaws opened, and the cold that poured out of them was the heart of a glacier, the end of the world.

pages_say.description: The ancient Jeskai khan and ghostfire warrior who convenes a summit of the khans and sacrifices himself to Ojutai to spare his clan.
The ancient Jeskai khan who convenes the khans and offers his life to Ojutai to spare his clan.
A figure who made a bargain that all ghostfire warriors would die to spare the rest of the Jeskai.
A leader of the Jeskai before the fall whom Tae Jin's mother served as scribe, who liked his secrets.
A Jeskai leader at the last meeting of the khans.
